# "A Day in the Life of Insects: Bees" - Full Documentary Project Overview

## About the Film
"A Day in the Life of Insects: Bees. A Ugandan Filmmaker's Cut" is an intimate, cinematic wildlife documentary exploring the intricate society of bees from within their colony, directed and filmed by Ugandan independent filmmaker Nathan Binomugisha.

While traditional nature documentaries observe insects from a distance, this project utilizes specialized macro and micro-cinematography to immerse viewers directly into the hive: feeling the morning dew on a bee's wing, navigating the wildflower canopy, and revealing the complex collaboration, agriculture, and quiet drama that sustains our ecosystems.

## About the Filmmaker
Nathan Binomugisha is an independent documentary filmmaker based in Uganda, East Africa. His filmmaking focuses on uncovering nature's smallest wonders and highlighting East Africa's rich biodiversity.

## Production Budget & Allocation ($15,000 USD Goal)
- Specialized macro and micro-cinematography camera equipment & optical lenses
- Field production and travel across remote conservation sites in Uganda
- Post-production, editing, color grading, sound design, and custom score composition
- International film festival submissions and global distribution
- Educational outreach materials for East African environmental conservation

## Production Timeline
- December 2025 - March 2026: Pre-production, research, and hive preparation
- February 2026 - August 2026: Field filming and macro production
- September 2026 - March 2027: Post-production, audio engineering, and mastering
- 2027: Premiere screenings, film festival circuit, and digital release for supporters

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is this campaign about?
This campaign funds the production of "A Day in the Life of Insects: Bees. A Ugandan Filmmaker's Cut" — an intimate documentary exploring the world of bees from within their society, filmed in Uganda by Nathan Binomugisha.

### How can I support?
1. Request payment details via the campaign website (Payoneer, Uganda Mobile Money, or Bank Transfer) or message us on WhatsApp.
2. Receive custom secure payment instructions via email or WhatsApp within 24 hours.
3. Complete your payment.
4. Send your payment receipt or screenshot to services@binomugisha.org or WhatsApp (+256 705 377 130) to receive project updates and a film credit.

### When will the film be released?
Production is underway through 2026, with post-production scheduled for completion by March 2027. Backers receive private early viewing access before public release.

### How will my contribution be used?
100% of contributions directly fund production equipment, field logistics in Uganda, sound design, musical scoring, festival submissions, and educational outreach.
